'''Gabriela''' is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game. She is a vampire whose lineage could be traced to an ancient Vampire Lord who once ruled the Eastern Lands.

==Debut Appearance==
Gabriela first appears in [[Raid:X5|Raid X5]], aiding the Summoner and Adriesta to fight [[Kielazar (character)|Kielazar]].
